# 📊 Data Science Journey

Welcome to my **Data Science Journey** repository! This repo documents my learning process, hands-on practice, mini-projects, and exploration into the world of Data Science, Machine Learning, and Data Analytics.

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack & Tools

- **Programming Languages:** Python
- **Data Manipulation & Analysis:** Pandas, NumPy
- **Data Visualization:** Matplotlib, Seaborn
- **Machine Learning:** Scikit-Learn
- **Environment:** Jupyter Notebooks / Google Colab

---

## 📂 Repository Structure

```text
├── notebooks/        # Jupyter notebooks with code experiments & analysis
├── datasets/         # Sample datasets used for practice
├── projects/         # End-to-end mini projects
└── README.md         # Repository documentation


🚀 What's Inside
​Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Cleaning datasets, handling missing values, and uncovering insights.
​Data Visualization: Plotting trends, distributions, and correlations using Matplotlib and Seaborn.
​Machine Learning Models: Implementing foundational algorithms (Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, etc.).
​📈 Goals
​Build a strong foundation in core statistics and Python programming for data.
​Solve real-world data challenges and document the process.
​Build a portfolio of impactful data projects.
